[MUSIC SEED STACK]
[COMMUNAL INFECTION — strength 88/100]
Begin with a limited vocal/social population. Let participation spread by trigger: answers, claps, stomps, shouted repeats, brief unisons, and chants accumulate section by section. Do not start with everybody already yelling.
[CALL + RESPONSE — strength 88/100]
Make calls generate actual responses with different timing or information. Answers may contradict, complete, rhythmically reinterpret, or physically reinforce the call.
[TOWNSHIP RHYTHMIC BRIGHTNESS — strength 88/100]
Use bright clipped/offbeat guitar behavior, springy bass motion, handclap participation, and optional pennywhistle-like melodic brightness as structural rhythmic vocabulary. Keep it urban, kinetic, and musical; avoid safari imagery, generic "tribal" language, or decorative exoticism.
[GROUP UNISON BURST — strength 88/100]
Use brief high-impact group unisons as punctuation rather than continuous choir texture. The burst should feel socially recruited and rhythmically exact.
[ANCHOR SURVIVAL — strength 88/100]
Choose a compact riff, contour, phrase, rhythm cell, or whistle-like hook as invariant. Let surrounding systems mutate aggressively. The anchor may return scarred, but identity must remain audible.
[CONTROL: STEMMINESS 74/100 — keep important roles distinguishable with periodic exposure.]
[CONTROL: KINETIC DENSITY 79/100 — maintain relentless event flow without sacrificing legibility.]
[CONTROL: SOCIAL INFECTION 87/100 — let excitement spread visibly from one performer to many.]
[CONTROL: COUPLING 74/100 — permit occasional competing groupings.]
[CONTROL: INTERRUPTION 60/100 — use periodic structural cuts.]
[CONTROL: ANCHOR STRENGTH 73/100 — return recognizable material after mutation.]
[CONTROL: CAST SIZE 79/100 — use a populated cast with clearly separated vocal jobs.]
[STACK INTERACTION: GENOME LAW — MOB COUPLED OFFSPRING #2 [generation 1]: Shared invariant: COMMUNAL INFECTION survives the crossover unchanged. COMMUNAL INFECTION ↔ TOWNSHIP RHYTHMIC BRIGHTNESS: social/vocal growth must alter physical texture through breath, clap, stomp, consonant attack, or another separately audible body layer.]

[ENSEMBLE TOPOLOGY: ANTIPHONAL CHOIRS — enforce who owns each phrase, fact, response, overlap, or interruption.]
[PHYSICAL GESTURES: BREATH-GATED PHRASING + STOMP / FLOOR RESONANCE — make gesture alter timing, breath, articulation, or body-percussion rather than acting as silent stage direction.]
[TUNING: SUBHARMONIC / UNDERTONE-DERIVED FIELD — make interval relationships obey this pitch world instead of defaulting silently to 12-TET.]
[RHYTHMIC PHYSICS: STOCHASTIC EVENT DENSITY + CO-PRIME CYCLE INTERLOCK — keep every selected clock/cycle/process audible and separately traceable.]
[ROLE EXCHANGE: BREATH → BASS FUNCTION + FEEDBACK → BASSLINE — explicitly transfer the named musical jobs while preserving recognizable source identity.]
[TEMPORAL ENGINE: MISSING INTERVAL — change objective chronology, recurrence, branching, causal order, or time-window structure. Do not confuse this with subjective altered-state time.]
[SCALE ENGINE: NEIGHBORHOOD — change which objects, causes, measurements, and operations are available at this scale.]
[EPISTEMOLOGY: SPEAKER KNOWS MORE THAN LISTENER — enforce who knows what, what counts as evidence, and how information may be acquired or disclosed.]
[AUDIENCE FEEDBACK: HECKLING CHANGES LYRICS — listener reaction must causally alter a named compositional variable.]
